verdict.rationale: The only pricing-related evidence is a snippet from Zep's pricing page listing deployment options (Cloud, Your VPC). It does not mention a free tier, per-unit rates, or anything that would let an engineer project memory costs. Pricing is a fair axis for a hosted memory service, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published pricing with a free tier and per-unit rates so I can project memory costs before committing
